svg.aria-label: Nine rung-100 load cells — one, three and five workers crossed with ten, thirty and sixty second service times, fifteen users each: measured drain time landed within 0.5 to 6.0 percent of the predicted ceiling N over W times S in every cell, and all 135 jobs were served with nothing shed.
svg.title: Nine cells, every one within 6% of the predicted drain time

g.title: error against the predicted makespan, the ceiling of N over W times S, from 0 to 6 percent

3 workers, 10 s · predicted 50 s, measured 52.1 s · 4.2% over; three workers drained 2.97 to 2.99 times faster than one
3 workers, 30 s · predicted 150 s, measured 152.3 s · 1.5% over

5 workers, 60 s · predicted 180 s, measured 181.6 s · 0.9% over
every cell served all fifteen users: 135 of 135 jobs completed, none shed, none timed out
